ValidationRule.description: Requires Follow_Up_Date__c to be filled when Status is Nurturing or Nurturing - Contacted
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Nurturing"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Nurturing - Contacted") ), ISBLANK(Follow_Up_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Follow-up Date is required when Lead status is Nurturing or Nurturing - Contacted.
